title: Weighted Fourier sum bounded by one
statement:
Let $k \ge 1$ and $n$ be integers, fix $j \in \mathbb{Z}/k\mathbb{Z}$ and a function $f : \mathbb{Z}_k^n \to \mathbb{Z}/k\mathbb{Z}$, and let $\widetilde{f}_j(x) = \omega_k^{\,j\,f(x)}$ be its $j$-twisted lift, with Fourier coefficients $\widehat{\widetilde{f}_j}(s)$ indexed by frequencies $s \in \mathbb{Z}_k^n$. Then
\[
  \sum_{s \in \mathbb{Z}_k^n}
    \bigl\lvert \widehat{\widetilde{f}_j}(s) \bigr\rvert^{2}\,
    \operatorname{Re}\widehat{\widetilde{f}_j}(s)
  \;\le\; 1,
\]
where $\lvert\cdot\rvert$ denotes the complex modulus and $\operatorname{Re}$ the real part.
